research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Yodlee is researching systems for financial information enrichment for intelligent credit decision making, predicting recurrence from financial data, and multi-dimensional credit worthiness evaluation. Their work includes quantifying the primacy of financial relations, financial account authentication, synthesizing user transactional data for de-identifying sensitive information, context-based data-driven classification, investment transaction enrichment, financial-based recommendation engines, and mobile application-based account aggregation. These areas reflect a focus on advanced financial data processing and user-centric financial solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Yodlee is a provider of financial applications that offers solutions for banks, entrepreneurs and individuals.

product.name: Data Aggregation Platform
product.description: A platform that collects and consolidates financial data from over 17,000 global sources to provide comprehensive financial information.

product.name: Credit Matrix
product.description: A solution providing alternative lending data by analyzing consumer cash flow, income, and assets to support credit decisioning.

product.name: Account Verification
product.description: A real-time service to verify and authenticate bank account ownership and details without micro-deposits.

product.name: Data Analytics
product.description: Analytics service that provides de-identified spending trends and transaction data insights for investors, corporations, and market researchers.

product.name: Open Banking APIs
product.description: APIs that provide secure, consumer-permissioned access to financial data in compliance with open banking standards and regulations.
